title: Managing Stress During Ramadan Fasting
paragraphs: During his first Ramadan while working a demanding job, Anas struggled to manage both fasting and a heavy meeting schedule, often feeling irritable by mid-afternoon despite his best efforts.
A colleague who had years of experience balancing both suggested rescheduling his most demanding tasks to the morning, when his energy was naturally higher after Suhoor.
Anas also started taking short breaks to rest quietly rather than pushing through fatigue, which surprisingly made him more productive during the hours he was actually working.

By the final week of Ramadan, Anas had developed a sustainable rhythm, realizing that working differently during fasting, rather than working the exact same way while ignoring his body, made all the difference.
